bio.text: Brent Andersen is the Republican nominee for Florida's 20th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the August 18 primary.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Nichols College in 2000 and works as an insurance broker.
According to his Ballotpedia survey, he founded Pilgrim Bay Insurance Agency in 2010 and lives in Pompano Beach with his wife and daughter.
